purpose: Behavior-preserving extraction of the production restore password Modal adapter, consumed by GeneralSettingsPage, plus real DOM coverage. No confirmed product defect is claimed.

first_run.detail: All nine semantic DOM scenarios executed, Node10/tsc/build passed, but runner exception gate detected the existing empty-password undefined Promise rejection propagated by AntD ActionButton.

expected_rejection: Fixture-only one-shot listener armed by the exact empty confirm button click, requiring original connected empty input and zero submissions, accepts exactly one undefined rejection then removes itself; missing/other/repeated exceptions still fail. Shared runner and production behavior unchanged.
coverage: Empty input retains dialog and warning, then correction submits once.
Cancel and Escape do not submit; Enter in input does not submit, Enter on focused confirm submits once.
Wrong-attempt hint with fresh input; nonempty whitespace preserved; void fire-and-forget callback preserved.
Production recursive restoreFlow retains original synthetic filename/SHA closure through two password retries.
limits: Not full GeneralSettingsPage/native IPC/live credentials/real restore or filesystem write acceptance.
Synthetic fixed passwords only. Static Modal theme inheritance means no dark-theme visual acceptance claim; screenshots not retained for review.
Only targeted Node and DOM groups; full frontend/browser/Rust suites not run.
